verdict.rationale: First-party docs say Bugbot analyzes every PR diff for bugs, security vulnerabilities, and code quality issues, and leaves inline comments with explanations and suggested fixes. That covers security findings reported alongside functional bugs. Teams can add their own review guidance through `.cursor/BUGBOT.md`, and community users confirm it finds real bugs, though they don't mention security findings specifically. Missing for 10: documentation of the specific security categories in the story (injection risks, leaked or hardcoded secrets, insecure patterns), any detail on security-detection depth or how severity is classified, and independent or hands-on corroboration that it catches security issues.
